basic_profile.bio: I'm a 40-year-old piercing enthusiast and amateur body modification historian based in Boston, MA. I work as a graphic designer during the day and am often online in the evenings. I have a deep interest in alternative fashion, especially anything related to body art and piercings. I've been in a long-term relationship for 8 years with my partner, who shares my passion for unique body art. I dislike close-mindedness and appreciate open discussions on new trends. When I’m not on Reddit, I love exploring the streets of Boston, discovering new coffee shops, and attending local music gigs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a wealth of knowledge about piercings and body modifications gained through personal experience, friendships with professional piercers, and extensive reading on the subject. My background as a graphic designer gives me a keen eye for aesthetic detail, which I apply to my interest in body art.
